evaluation_scope.statement: All group-held-out test flows are retained.

coverage.holdout_policy: All deterministic test-split flows are retained and evaluated. The training and validation pools use bounded reservoirs only to limit frozen-encoder work outside the held-out evaluation population.
coverage.interpretation: Counts are after the deterministic group split and configured per-split retention. A null test cap retains the complete holdout population; these counts are checked before frozen-encoder inference and classifier fitting.

projection.pca_fit_scope: all corpus train rows, including unresolved rows; no validation/test
